I was lucky to get FISP coupons this year, so I will apply NPK and urea on my maize plot because without fertilizer the soil gives nothing. I also have some goat manure that I will mix into the planting holes along with the chemical fertilizer. I will plant the hybrid maize seed from the subsidy program since it grows better than the local seed I kept before. We do not spray chemicals on maize here, and there is no water for irrigation, so we depend on the rains from November; my family will do most of the work, but I will hire ganyu workers for about ten days to help with weeding when the grass is thick.
